name: fastsim_veto_c4_run1a
note: First veto-rule study (tier C4 of the CRV veto optimisation; fastsimkit task veto_c4 on Fermilab EAF): two knobs of the veto card (the upper edge of the track-coincidence time window and the coincidence PE threshold) applied to the cached Run 1A selection run1a_dev (S. Grant's dev cut set on nts.mu2e.CosmicSignalOnSpillTriggered.MDC2025-000, 10,279 CE-like cosmic tracks, 85-200 MeV/c). Objective: the veto inefficiency on these cosmics, to minimise. Not a physics optimisation: without the deadtime objective (signal + beam, not built yet) the optimum is the widest window and the lowest threshold; the study exercises the C4 tier end to end through Mu2eBO.
